notes: Fight DNA got a lot smarter. It now judges every attack thrown at you fairly: did you block, dodge or counter it (and how fast, and did it work), step out of range, throw back into it, or just take it? Getting hit while stunned or knocked down isn't held against you, and a block you pressed too late still counts as trying. Your clone defends exactly as often and as quickly as you do (late blockers block late, people who don't defend don't). It also learns your real combos string by string and throws your favourites, what you do straight out of a dodge, whether you punish misses, and how much you charge your attacks. The Fight DNA card shows your defence style, reaction time, how often your blocks land in time, and your favourite combos.
